name: Inside Agentic AI: Core Architecture of Agentic Systems
description:
Skillsoft issued completion badges are earned based on viewing the percentage required or receiving a passing score when assessment is required. Agentic AI systems operate through a core architecture, and this course takes you under the hood to reveal how that architecture enables them to function autonomously.

In this course, explore how architectural components work together to create intelligent agents through visually engaging diagrams and practical workflows. Next, discover the unique design patterns and capabilities of frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, and CrewAI. Finally, learn how to apply an architectural lens to design, debug, and optimize real-world agentic systems with clarity and confidence.

After completing this course, you will be able to outline how modern agents operate and how to think like one.
